title: Jab aaya shaam ka bazaar
body:
JAB AAYA SHAAM KA BAAZAR TADAP KAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
AYAA HAI HASHR KE AASAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
MOHAMMED KE GHARAANE KI HUVI KAISI YE BARBAADI
PHIRAAYA KOOCHA-O-BAAZAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
KABHI BABA KE AAGE BHI JO BEPARDA NA AAYI THI
BAREHNA SAR HAI AUR AGIYAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
KATA SAJDE ME SAR SHEH KA LUTA KARBAL ME GHAR SHEH KA
CHALI HAI QALB PE TALWAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
AY MERE BEKAFAN BABA SAKINA MARGAYI BABA
KARE TO KYA KARE LAACHAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
SAKINA KE CHINE GAUHAR TAMAACHON KE NASHAA RUKHPAR
YE SAB SEHTI RAHI GHAMQAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
NABI KI AAL AUR QAIDI YE KYA AJRE RISALAT THI
GAYE JAB SHAAM KA DARBAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
YE HAI BEEMAAR KA MAATAM KARO ZANJEER KA MAATAM
SUNO ZANJEER KI JHANKAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJJAD
YE NAUHA JAB PADHA ROKAR QAYAAMAT AAGAYI ASGAR
MASAAYAB KE TERE AMBAAR TADAPKAR REHGAYE SAJAAD
